shots.ocr:
@ © @ — enwikipedia.org/wiki/Three-toed_sloth

Three-toed sloth

The three-toed sloths are arboreal neotropical mammals. They are the only members of the genus Bradypus and the family
Bradypodidae. The four living species are the brown-throated sloth, the maned sloth, the pale-throated sloth, and the pygmy three-toed
sloth.

Sloths move slowly to conserve energy. Their diet of leaves provides little energy, and digestion can take weeks. They come down from

the trees about once a week to defecate.

Description

Three-toed sloths are about the size of a small dog, with a head and body length of around 45 cm and a weight of 3.5 to 4.5 kg.

shots.ocr:
eee dev.to/someone/calling-an-open-model-api-in-5-lines

Calling an open model API in 5 lines

Posted on Oct 9 - 3 min read

Set your key as an environment variable first, never paste it into code you commit.

export MODEL_API_KEY="YOUR_API_KEY_ HERE"

curl https://api.example-models.dev/v1/chat \
-H "Authorization: Bearer $MODEL_API KEY" \
-d '{"model": "gemma-4-e2b", "messages": [...]}'

If you see a 401, the variable is not set in the shell you are using.
